name: Making Out
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor the sanctity of marriage and to remain faithful within that covenant, as seen in Hebrews 13:4 which declares the marriage bed undefiled and warns of judgment on adulterers. The call to purity extends to avoiding all forms of sexual immorality, including fornication and uncleanness, which are identified as works of the flesh in Galatians 5:19 and forbidden among the saints in Ephesians 5:3. Proverbs 5:15 encourages exclusive intimacy within one's own marriage, symbolized by drinking water from one's own cistern, underscoring the value of faithfulness and self-control. Believers are exhorted in Colossians 3:5 to put to death earthly desires such as inordinate affection and evil lust, recognizing these as spiritually harmful and idolatrous.
